WITH filtered_standings AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name as race_name,
    ds.points
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0
),
race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    race_name,
    AVG(points) as avg_points
  FROM filtered_standings
  GROUP BY race_name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_points) as overall_avg
  FROM race_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.race_name,
  ra.avg_points,
  ra.avg_points - oa.overall_avg as difference
FROM race_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ra.avg_points > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY ra.race_name;
